paper.title_en: Weak Cosmic Censorship in Einstein-Born-Infeld Black Hole: A Parameter-Space Analysis
paper.abstract_en: Einstein-Born-Infeld is a charged black hole solution of general relativity with Born-Infeld nonlinear electrodynamics, which has interesting physical features. It violates Bekenstein's entropy upper bound, and it can overcharge with respect to the Reissner-Nordström black hole. It presents an optimum situation to test the cosmic censorship conjecture, which is another important conjecture in black hole physics. In principle, this analysis requires the calculation of the self-energy of a test particle in the vicinity of the black hole, which, in general, is not feasible because of the electromagnetic nonlinearities. In this work, we propose an alternative approach that allows us to explore the whole parameter space of the Einstein-Born-Infeld black hole and test the validity of the cosmic censorship conjecture.

decision.title_zh: Einstein-Born-Infeld黑洞中的弱宇宙监督：参数空间分析
decision.abstract_zh: Einstein-Born-Infeld是广义相对论中带有Born-Infeld非线性电动力学的带电黑洞解，具有有趣的物理特征。它违反Bekenstein熵上界，并且相对于Reissner-Nordström黑洞可以发生过充电。它提供了一个检验宇宙监督猜想的理想情形，该猜想是黑洞物理中另一个重要的猜想。原则上，这一分析需要计算黑洞附近试探粒子的自能，而由于电磁非线性，这通常难以实现。在本工作中，我们提出一种替代方法，使我们能够探索Einstein-Born-Infeld黑洞的整个参数空间，并检验宇宙监督猜想的有效性。
